headline: Atomos Brand Monitoring Report for 2026-10-31

coverage.summary: An article discussing firmware updates for Nikon Z8 and other cameras, highlighting compatibility issues and new features, including support for Atomos external recorders.
A forum post inquiring about the compatibility between Tilta's Nucleus-M lens control system and Atomos recorders, specifically the Ninja Assassin model.

visibility_gaps: GPT retail/product sources are treated as unverified leads, not new verified social mentions.
methodology: Conducted a comprehensive search for Atomos-related content on Reddit, YouTube, DPReview, Blackmagic Design, RED, Sony, videography forums, and other relevant platforms, focusing on posts and articles dated October 31, 2026. Prioritized original sources mentioning Atomos products in the context of camera recording, firmware, and related topics. Excluded content unrelated to Atomos professional video production hardware.
